title: The importance of counterion association in the calculated binding constants of Ca2+-aminopolycarboxylate complexes
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15165-15175
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07375H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mojgan Heshmat, Pavlo Kostetskyy, Guanna Li, Daan S. van Es
In this work, using a set of benchmark aminopolycarboxylate ligands, we calculate binding affinities for a number of chelator-ion systems and investigate the effect of including counterion Na+ association on the calculated binding constant.
